text: The purpose of this report is to have City Council appoint two members of the public to the Toronto Music Advisory Committee to fill current vacancies due to recent resignations.

City Council on February 2, 3 and 5, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidates to the Toronto Music Advisory Committee, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022: Randell Adjei Phoenix Pagliacci
